feat: add comprehensive Kubernetes deployment and production-ready Docker configuration

This commit adds complete Kubernetes deployment capabilities and production-ready
Docker configurations optimized for the IDP platform with Argo Workflows CI/CD.

## 🚀 Major Features Added

### Kubernetes Deployment
- Complete K8s manifests for microservices deployment (backend + frontend)
- Istio service mesh integration with VirtualService and DestinationRule
- WebApplication CRD support for IDP platform operator
- RBAC configuration with ServiceAccount and ClusterRole
- HorizontalPodAutoscaler for automatic scaling (2-10 replicas)

### Argo Workflows CI/CD
- Multi-stage Docker build workflow using Kaniko
- Support for backend, frontend, and fullstack image builds
- Integration with LocalStack ECR and production registries
- Secure, non-root container builds

### Production Docker Configuration
- Enhanced multi-stage Dockerfile with security optimizations
- Kubernetes-optimized health checks and security contexts
- Fixed fullstack container with proper tar extraction
- SSL configuration for external AWS RDS connectivity

### Environment & Secrets Management
- Comprehensive environment variable configuration (70+ variables)
- OAuth2 and GitHub integration support
- AWS RDS database connectivity
- Kubernetes Secrets and ConfigMaps separation
- Production-ready secret management templates

### Deployment Tooling
- `k8s-deploy.sh` - Kubernetes deployment automation script
- `setup-env.sh` - Interactive environment setup with auto-generated secrets
- Enhanced `deploy.sh` with Kubernetes deployment options
- Comprehensive deployment documentation

## 🔧 Technical Improvements

### Docker Enhancements
- Fixed workspace conflicts in multi-stage builds
- Added proper tar extraction for Backstage backend bundles
- Environment variable passthrough for OAuth2 and integrations
- Health endpoints for Kubernetes probes

### Security & Compliance
- Non-root container execution (users 1001/101)
- Kubernetes security contexts and pod security policies
- mTLS service mesh integration
- RBAC with least-privilege access

### Scalability & Observability
- Prometheus metrics integration
- Structured JSON logging
- Distributed tracing support
- Resource requests and limits configuration

## 📁 Files Added
- `k8s/` - Complete Kubernetes manifests directory
- `argo-workflows/build-workflow.yaml` - CI/CD pipeline
- `k8s-deploy.sh` - Kubernetes deployment script
- `setup-env.sh` - Environment setup automation
- `.env.example` - Comprehensive environment template
- `K8S-DEPLOYMENT.md` - Deployment documentation

## 🔄 Files Modified
- `Dockerfile` - Enhanced with K8s optimizations and security
- `docker-compose.yml` - Added comprehensive environment variable support
- `deploy.sh` - Added Kubernetes deployment references
- `packages/app/package.json` - Minor dependency updates

## 🎯 Ready for Production
This configuration is production-ready for:
- IDP Kubernetes platform deployment
- GitOps workflows with ArgoCD
- Service mesh integration with Istio
- OAuth2 authentication with GitHub
- External AWS RDS database connectivity
- Comprehensive monitoring and observability
